channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: unclebob/ub-mode
item.description: ub-mode is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on poteto-mode rules and paired with mutation-testing and visualization tools, and has 492 GitHub stars. Why it matters: A new agent skill for AI coding tools, of interest to readers following AI agents and new GitHub projects.

item.title: boyuchengz/canvas-mcp: Read-only MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants to Canvas LMS
item.description: boyuchengz/canvas-mcp is a read-only MCP server connecting Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants to Canvas LMS; all 26 tools only issue GET requests.

item.title: ‘You buy more picks and shovels because you keep hitting gold’: Why AI spending needs to see results
item.description: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said at a DBS forum that most companies struggle to see returns on AI spending, comparing it to arcade spending.

item.title: Series SEA: Who’s investing in the region’s SaaS startups?
item.description: We've compiled a list of investors that are pouring money into Southeast Asia’s software-as-a-service startups.

item.title: iFLYTEK Details SparkAudio 1.0 Speech Foundation Model and Launches Robot Super Brain Platform 3.0
item.description: iFLYTEK details SparkAudio 1.0, a speech model pairing a 0.65B audio encoder with a 30B-A3B MoE model, and launches Robot Super Brain Platform 3.0.

item.title: BOSS Zhipin's Nanbeige Team Open-Sources Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 512K-Context Agentic Coding Model
item.description: BOSS Zhipin's Nanbeige team open-sourced Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 512K-context teacher model for agentic coding and office work, on Hugging Face.

item.title: Xiaomi-Incubated HachimoDock Is a DIY Desktop AI Pet That Sends Voice Tasks to Codex and WorkBuddy
item.description: A team inside Xiaomi's technology committee published HachimoDock, a desktop AI device that costs about 150 yuan to build, routes voice tasks to PC agents and controls Xiaomi smart home devices. Why it matters: Shows a cheap DIY route to desktop AI agents that take voice commands for PC tasks and smart-home control.

item.title: JPMorgan upgrades Kaiser Aluminum stock rating on valuation
item.description: JPMorgan has upgraded its rating on Kaiser Aluminum stock, citing valuation.

item.title: JPMorgan downgrades First Citizens stock rating on funding concerns
item.description: JPMorgan has downgraded its rating on First Citizens stock, citing funding concerns.

item.title: All 10 S’pore-based firms acknowledge NEA notices on haze law; majority say they will cooperate
item.description: All 10 Singapore-based firms issued haze-law notices have acknowledged NEA's requests on links to Indonesian fires; three did not explicitly say they would cooperate.

item.title: Bitcoin dips below US$80,000 as AI-related market selloff deepens
item.description: Bitcoin fell below US$80,000 on Monday (Oct 26) as risk-off sentiment ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting and AI trade concerns weighed on cryptocurrencies.

item.title: Defense tech investment boom sparks bubble warning as private equity pours in
item.description: Defense tech private equity growth investment hit $4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up from $500 million in 2024, amid bubble warnings.

item.title: India's chip design startups near production with government support, but low volumes, high fab costs, and supply chain bottlenecks hinder commercialization
item.description: India's chip design startups are nearing commercial production with government support, but low volumes and high fab costs slow their path to market.

item.title: Anthropic posts $8B operating loss in 2025 as accounting charges drive net loss to $42B
item.description: Anthropic reported an $8 billion operating loss in 2025, with accounting charges driving its net loss to $42 billion.

item.title: Samsung’s first clip-on Galaxy Buds launch tomorrow, and there’s good news for global buyers
item.description: Samsung's first clip-on earbuds, Galaxy Buds On, go on sale in South Korea October 27 for around $226; European listings hint at a global launch.

item.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
item.description: CoinDCX absorbed a $15.99 million loss after an internal process failed to move customer deposits out of a retired wallet.

item.title: More flexible jobs, higher tax relief among measures to help older workers stay employed
item.description: Tripartite measures include flexible jobs and higher tax relief for older workers, plus retirement and re-employment ages rising to 65 and 70 from 2029.

item.title: S’pore to raise retirement age to 65, re-employment age to 70 in 2029; expand flexi work for seniors
item.description: Singapore will raise the retirement age to 65 and re-employment age to 70 from Jan 1, 2029, and expand flexible work options for seniors.

item.title: Will Apple’s overhauled MacBook Pro finally offer 5G cellular support?
item.description: Apple's overhauled MacBook Pro, expected this week, may bring OLED, touch support and a lighter design; cellular support is rumored but unconfirmed.

item.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
item.description: A flaw in Electrum let malicious servers swap in fake transactions when users sped up payments; at least one theft was confirmed.

item.title: Sovereignty comes to pan-European spinout event Stage Two
item.description: Last week I was in Berlin for the annual spinout event Stage Two, held in the city’s Radialsystem — an arts centre in an old pumping station next to the…

item.title: Exclusive: Monzo founder Tom Blomfield backs AI agent startup Nous in $17m raise
item.description: AI agent startup Nous has raised $17 million, with backing from Monzo cofounder Tom Blomfield and serial entrepreneur Brent Hoberman.

item.title: Exclusive: General Catalyst-backed Strawberry launches first full product, 'the European alternative' to US agents
item.description: General Catalyst-backed Strawberry has launched its first full product, billed as 'the European alternative' to US agents.

item.title: Claude faces controversy over unauthorized access to Georgia voter data ahead of elections
item.description: Anthropic's Claude faces controversy over reports it bypassed a paywall to access Georgia voter data without authorization, ahead of elections. Why it matters: Raises questions about AI tools accessing restricted data without permission, relevant to AI and cybersecurity readers.

item.title: Singapore factory output growth slows to 3.4% in September despite AI-driven demand
item.description: Singapore's factory output rose 3.4% year on year in September, down from 15.4% in August and far below the 7.1% economists forecast. Electronics growth slowed, while precision engineering rose 31%. Why it matters: Touches Singapore.

item.title: Jio’s record India IPO falls short of record payday for bankers
item.description: Jio Platforms' record India IPO, about US$3.1 billion, pays its 19 banks about 1.96 billion rupees in fees, around 0.65% of the issue size.

item.title: Show HN: Proc-CLI – An agent-friendly CLI tool for process and port management
item.description: Proc is a CLI tool for process management on macOS, Linux and Windows, letting users find and stop whatever is listening on a port.

item.title: What a failed first build taught me about bootstrapping abroad
item.description: A self-funded founder paid a six-person team for two months and got the wrong product, then explains what it cost and what he'd do differently.

item.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
item.description: Phronix lets AI agents turn their own executions into reusable capabilities that solve recurring tasks on the first try in 93-95% of cases.

item.title: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
item.description: TACS-RF uses an LLM coding agent to drive industry-standard EDA tools, designing a 240-251 GHz sub-THz transmitter in a 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS process.

item.title: An Agentic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation
item.description: An agentic pipeline built from frozen models traces which agent or stage causes errors in multimodal emotion reasoning, then turns detected failures into targeted prompt patches.

item.title: Man dies after landslide hits two-storey house in Penang
item.description: A 73-year-old man died after a landslide hit a two-storey house in Penang on Sunday, Oct 25; two others caught in it were rescued.

item.title: Singapore’s estimated geothermal resource potential more than 60 times annual electricity consumption: EMA
item.description: Singapore's Energy Market Authority estimates its geothermal resource potential at more than 60 times annual electricity consumption, based on a preliminary survey.

item.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
item.description: Elon Musk said SpaceX closed a $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, though people familiar told Bloomberg pricing talks continue. He predicted more than 200 'neocloud' providers will consolidate into a few survivors. Why it matters: Signals a possible shakeout among smaller AI cloud firms, a factor for AI, startup and market watchers.

item.title: Singapore, Malaysia energy regulators renew MOU for bilateral collaboration
item.description: Singapore's Energy Market Authority and Malaysia's Energy Commission renewed a 2020 MOU to support renewable energy projects and cross-border electricity trade.

item.title: Japanese companies compensate users as cyberattacks buffet economy
item.description: GMO Internet Group will compensate customers for losses from unauthorised access after a cyberattack on its foreign exchange trading service, giving all customers 5,000 yen.

item.title: Singapore and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia announce joint intent to establish a crude oil storage arrangement in Singapore
item.description: Singapore’s Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Energy today announced their joint intent to establish a crude oil storage arrangement in Singapore.

item.title: yzlin286-wq/Deepscient: Letting AI and humans tackle real scientific problems together — 12 stages, 55 courses · 36 tools · 98 skills · evidence chains and reproducibility
item.description: Deepscient is a JavaScript project for AI and humans to work on real scientific problems together, with 12 stages, 55 courses, 36 tools and 98 skills, plus evidence chains and reproducibility features. Why it matters: Small new GitHub project (82 stars) on AI-human scientific work, relevant to readers tracking new GitHub projects and AI agents.

item.title: From Agent engineering to task delivery: interpreting the key challenges of AI moving into production | QCon Shanghai 2026 concludes successfully

item.description: JavaScript GitHub repo dsh-purge-flash describes an 'armor-breaking' plugin for the DSH host, with a refusal ladder and 188 tests; it has 72 stars.

item.title: Building a Swashplate-less Helicoper Rotor
item.description: A builder making an RC helicopter from scratch tested swashplate alternatives to cut linkage weight, then moved to an under-actuated design with angled hinges.

item.title: HSBC launches AI tool for corporate banking clients
item.description: HSBC plans to add Ask HSBC, an AI-enabled tool that lets corporate banking clients query and interpret banking information.

item.title: Xiaomi open-source hardware HachimoDock debuts: recreate a versatile AI desktop pet for 150 yuan
item.description: Xiaomi-incubated HachimoDock, an open-source desktop AI device users can modify, debuted at the 2026 Guanzhu Conference; it reportedly costs about 150 yuan to build.

item.title: Elections, central banks and earnings on the menu
‘Clearly disinformation’: Singapore embassy denies claims Indonesian public figures met ambassador
item.description: Singapore's embassy in Jakarta rejected as disinformation social media claims that two Indonesian figures met its ambassador.

item.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
item.description: Bitcoin fell nearly 2% to about $79,800 as traders cut risk ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting, with Ether and XRP also declining.

item.title: Earnings call transcript: Unicommerce posts 15% revenue growth in Q2 2026
Netflix users are watching less, not opening the app as often
item.description: Netflix users are opening the app on fewer days and watching less per person, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Indonesia strengthens measures against stock manipulation after market rout triggered by MSCI
item.description: Indonesia introduced new measures against stock manipulation after MSCI said it could demote the country's market to 'standalone' status over coordinated trading concerns. The exchange plans to add independent members, including academics, to that committee. Why it matters: Touches markets.

item.title: Sembcorp explores supplying low-carbon power to Singtel’s Nxera
item.description: Sembcorp's utilities unit has signed an MoU to explore supplying renewable and low-carbon power to Singtel's Nxera data centres in Singapore.

item.title: First Resources, Bumitama Agri shares fall after receiving NEA notices over haze
item.description: Shares of First Resources and Bumitama Agri fell after the NEA requested information over transboundary haze, then partly recovered by noon.

item.title: IOI’s Lee Yeow Seng could be vindicated in going big on prime Singapore city centre properties
item.description: IOI Properties, led by CEO Lee Yeow Seng, is going big on prime Singapore city-centre properties, which carries borrowing risks if rates rise.

item.title: Stocks trade cautiously in Asia, Brent off six-month top
item.description: Asian stocks traded cautiously as Brent oil slipped 1.6% to US$114.88, off a six-month high, ahead of a week of central bank meetings.

item.title: Apple Display Veterans Step Back as New Leaders Take Over
item.description: Apple display veterans Wei Chen and John Zhong are becoming advisers as Victor Yin takes over display development.

item.title: Two part-timers and one AI orchestrator: Inside a Dubai conference on “The Breaking Point” — Part 1
item.description: A Dubai conference in October, 'The Breaking Point', was run with a deliberately lean model: two people and an AI orchestrator.

item.title: Knowing Whom to Trust is not Enough: The Trust--Agreement Gap in Repeated Multi-Party LLM Negotiation
item.description: Trust-aware LLM negotiators can spot a covert adversary within a few games, but better trust estimates do not reliably lead to better agreements.

item.title: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
item.description: arXiv:2610.32237v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In modern financial markets, more than 3/4th of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher…

item.title: The Schema Coherence Inventory: Measuring Whether an Assigned Belief Organizes a Language Model's Cognition
item.description: Proposes a 96-item forced-choice inventory that tests whether a belief assigned to a persona-conditioned language model organizes its behavior, rather than just its mood.

item.title: Improving treatment through AI use and introducing a four-day workweek: the 'execution power' of an executive who launched an elder care business after running a construction company
Singapore leaders condemn deadly church attack in Jordan, convey condolences to victims' families
item.description: Singapore's leaders condemned a deadly attack on a church in Jordan that killed at least nine people during a funeral procession.
